name: @zudocs/eu-host
description: The Zudocs eu-west-1 host: what runs on the t4g.micro beside airprompterd — the Node ticket worker (attached to the daemon, approvals, the status writer), the Python worker, the import pass for the air-gapped host's telemetry exports, the systemd units and the boot script — and two Lambda functions beside the host: the wire (cuts and restores its egress) and the power (sleeps and wakes it, the nightly schedule).
